_nota: Escenas de los rosarios gozoso, glorioso y luminoso, en vertical como las del canal.

escenas.escena: Mary (exactly as in her reference image) kneels in prayer in her simple house in Nazareth while the archangel Gabriel, a radiant young figure with large white wings and white-golden robes, appears before her in soft light, one hand raised in greeting.
Close view of Mary (exactly as in her reference image), eyes lowered, hands crossed on her heart as she says yes to God; a white dove of the Holy Spirit glows in golden light above her.
The village of Nazareth at dawn among green hills: simple stone houses, one small window glowing with a heavenly golden light.
Mary (exactly as in her reference image) walks briskly along a mountain path through the green hills of Judea in spring, carrying a small bundle, wildflowers along the way.

Mary (exactly as in her reference image) and her elderly cousin Elizabeth (a grey-haired woman in her sixties, visibly pregnant, warm smile, soft green mantle) embrace with great joy at the doorway of a stone house.

Elizabeth (a grey-haired woman in her sixties, visibly pregnant, soft green mantle) holds her hands on her belly and praises Mary (exactly as in her reference image), who stands with hands joined in humble joy.

Mary (exactly as in her reference image) and Saint Joseph (a kind man in his thirties with a short dark beard, brown tunic and beige mantle) kneel in adoration before the newborn Jesus lying in a wooden manger on straw, in a humble stable in Bethlehem at night, an ox and a donkey nearby, warm lamplight.
Close view of Mary (exactly as in her reference image) tenderly holding the newborn Jesus wrapped in white swaddling cloths, gazing at him with infinite love.
The little town of Bethlehem at night under a deep blue starry sky, one bright star shining above a humble stable on the hillside.

Mary (exactly as in her reference image) carries the infant Jesus and Saint Joseph (a kind man in his thirties with a short dark beard, brown tunic and beige mantle) carries a pair of white turtledoves as they climb the steps into the Temple of Jerusalem, golden stone and morning light.

The elderly Simeon (long white beard, cream and blue robes) holds the infant Jesus in his arms and looks up to heaven with tears of joy, inside the Temple; Mary (exactly as in her reference image) and Saint Joseph (a kind man in his thirties with a short dark beard, brown tunic and beige mantle) stand beside him.
Inside the Temple of Jerusalem, Mary (exactly as in her reference image) receives the infant Jesus back into her arms, pensive and loving, a ray of light falling through the columns.

The twelve-year-old Jesus (a boy with dark curly hair and a cream tunic, bright wise eyes) sits among elderly teachers of the Law with scrolls in the Temple of Jerusalem, listening and asking questions; the teachers are amazed.

Mary (exactly as in her reference image) and Saint Joseph (a kind man in his thirties with a short dark beard, brown tunic and beige mantle) find the twelve-year-old Jesus (dark curly hair, cream tunic) in the Temple; Mary reaches out to him with relief and love.

The Holy Family walks home together along a road towards Nazareth at sunset: Mary (exactly as in her reference image), Saint Joseph (a kind man in his thirties with a short dark beard, brown tunic and beige mantle) and the twelve-year-old Jesus (dark curly hair, cream tunic) between them.
The empty tomb at dawn: the great round stone rolled away, an angel in dazzling white robes sitting on it, three holy women carrying jars of spices arriving in awe.
The risen Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) stands in a garden at dawn surrounded by radiant light, in shining white garments, arms slightly open, serene joy on his face.
Close view of the risen Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) raising his hand in blessing, sunrise light behind him, peaceful and glorious.
Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) rises into the sky above a hill near Bethany, hands raised in blessing, in white garments and golden light; the apostles below look up in wonder.
The apostles stand on a hilltop looking up at the clouds with awe and hope, golden rays of light streaming down.

Close view of Mary (exactly as in her reference image), standing in the foreground with her hands joined in prayer and her eyes raised to heaven with peaceful joy; behind her, a few apostles on a hilltop also look up at a sky full of golden light. Mary is the clear protagonist, in the center.

Mary (exactly as in her reference image) sits praying in the center of the twelve apostles in an upper room in Jerusalem; small tongues of fire rest above each head and a radiant white dove shines above, a strong wind moving their robes.
Close view of several apostles filled with joy and courage, small flames of fire above their heads, golden light in the upper room.
A radiant white dove of the Holy Spirit with outstretched wings in a burst of golden light and soft flames.
Mary (exactly as in her reference image) is lifted up to heaven by gentle angels, arms open, white and blue robes, among luminous clouds and golden light.
Close view of Mary (exactly as in her reference image) in glory, looking up towards heaven with joy, surrounded by soft golden light and clouds.
The apostles gather in wonder around Mary's empty tomb, filled with white lilies and roses, morning light.
Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) places a golden crown on the head of Mary (exactly as in her reference image), who kneels humbly before him in heaven among clouds and adoring angels.
Mary (exactly as in her reference image) as the woman clothed with the sun, standing on a crescent moon, with a crown of twelve stars around her head, in the heavens.
Close view of Mary (exactly as in her reference image) as Queen of Heaven, a crown of twelve stars above her head, gentle motherly gaze towards the viewer.
Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) stands waist-deep in the river Jordan while John the Baptist (wild dark hair and beard, camel-hair garment) pours water over his head from a shell.
The heavens open in golden light and a white dove descends over Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) as he comes up out of the river Jordan.
The river Jordan at sunrise among reeds and palm trees, rays of light falling on the calm water.
A joyful wedding feast in a courtyard in Cana with lamps and guests; Mary (exactly as in her reference image) leans towards Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) and speaks to him quietly.
Servants fill six large stone water jars to the brim while Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) watches and Mary (exactly as in her reference image) stands nearby with a gentle smile.
A servant pours deep red wine from a stone jar into a cup, astonished, at the wedding feast in Cana, warm lamplight.
Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) preaches to a large crowd seated on a green hillside by the Sea of Galilee, one hand raised, the lake shining behind.
Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) lifts up with tenderness a repentant man kneeling before him in tears, forgiving him, people watching.
Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) walks with his disciples through golden wheat fields in Galilee at sunset.

On a high mountain top, Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) is transfigured: his face shines like the sun and his garments are dazzling white; the apostles Peter (grey beard), James and John (younger) have fallen to the ground in awe.

The transfigured Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) in dazzling white light, with Moses (elderly, long white beard, holding stone tablets) and Elijah (elderly, rough mantle) on either side, on the mountain top.
A bright luminous cloud covers the top of a high mountain, rays of golden light breaking through, three small figures of apostles kneeling below.
The Last Supper: Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) at the table with his twelve apostles in an upper room lit by oil lamps, lifting a loaf of bread and blessing it.
Close view of Jesus (exactly as in his reference image) lifting a simple cup of wine, eyes raised to heaven, giving thanks, warm lamplight.
A broken loaf of bread and a simple chalice of wine on a wooden table in soft candlelight, reverent and still.
